subject: Weekly MAP: Exec snapshot — SLA exception & priority support plan (Novaplace)
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha@novaplace.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: MAP: Urgent - SLA exception for inference latency (Novaplace)

Hi Vivek,

We hit repeated inference latency spikes on Friday during the marketplace batch window (median p95 went from 220ms -> 1.6s). This has affected the checkout flow and we opened internal incidents from our side. We've attached a short latency report from our monitoring (latency_report_nov2026.pdf).

Request: can we escalate this under our MAP and schedule a short executive-level checkpoint this week? We need:
- a short RCA window (what changed on Redwood side)
- a proposed immediate mitigation (priority support / temporary capacity bump)
- timeline for a permanent fix and credits for impacted minutes

Our CSM suggested looping in your MAP owners and an exec sponsor so we can close the loop with procurement. Let us know availability — mornings PST are best for our infra team.

Thanks,
Samantha Cole
Head of Platform, Novaplace

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Cole <samantha@novaplace.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Urgent - SLA exception for inference latency (Novaplace)

Following an initial infra sync:
- Short summary: Friday's spike correlates with an unexpected traffic burst to the batch endpoint that caused request queueing on the p4d pool serving that MAP. No config rollouts from our side in the window.
- Current mitigation plan:
  - Submit priority support ticket (SUP-12345) to routing & autoscaler (in progress) — Owner: Laura Bennett (I will submit by EOD PST)
  - Spin up temporary Dedicated pool targeted at Novaplace traffic for 48-72 hours (trial) — Owner: Aditya Rao to coordinate immediate capacity (ETA: 4 hours after approval)
  - Enable prefix/KV caching on the batch route to reduce token compute for identical requests — Owner: Runtime team (Aditya will follow up)

I've drafted an SLA exception request and initial credit calculation (sla_exception_request_draft.pdf). The credit calc is conservative — open to sponsor guidance.

Action items after checkpoint:
- Laura: open priority support ticket and attach telemetry (SUP-12345)
- Aditya: confirm capacity plan and runbook for rollback
- Vivek: prepare exec brief for sponsor approval with three options (credit, capacity trial, long-term optimizations)

Quoting Samantha's original note below for context.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Cole <samantha@novaplace.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T07:45:00-08:00
Subject: Exec snapshot for sponsor — Novaplace MAP SLA exception (summary + ask)

Markus — quick executive snapshot for sponsor review and approval. Please see the short summary below; attaching a one-pager exec brief (exec_brief_snapshot.pdf).

Executive summary:
- What happened: Novaplace experienced p95 latency spikes (up to 1.6s) on 2026-11-20 during a high-volume batch window. Root cause appears to be a traffic burst to the existing p4d pool causing queueing. No customer-visible config changes from Redwood were found in the window.
- Immediate mitigation proposed: temporary Dedicated capacity trial (48-72h) + priority support escalation path.
- Compensation request: conservative credit equal to 15% of tokens served during impacted window (proposal drafted by Laura).
- Business impact: checkout failures for a subset of checkout flows — potential revenue exposure per Novaplace estimate.

Immediate asks for sponsor approval:
1) Approve Dedicated trial for Novaplace (Owner: Aditya to execute upon approval)
2) Approve priority support SLA for the trial window (support to treat SUP-12345 as highest priority)
3) Approve the proposed credit (15% conservative ask) pending final finance confirmation

Planned timeline once approved:
- T+0: Aditya runs capacity spin-up (goal: <4 hours)
- T+1: Laura submits SUP-12345 with telemetry and escalates to routing and autoscaler
- T+2: Vivek routes exec brief to procurement for credit approval and signs off with sponsor

If you approve, I will mark the MAP checkpoint as complete and coordinate the trial kickoff with Novaplace.
